text:
Maya: quick async standup — what I did: validated KV warmup rollout on dedicated, repro'd the transient 504s on the batcher and applied a patch to backoff retries.

Maya: blockers: CI flaky test in autoscaler (race on pool resize) — prevents canary promotion. @Chris can you take a look at the failing test? test id: autoscaler_resize_test_7

Chris: looking — saw the same flake locally. it's a timing/race with goroutine shutdown. I'll add a small channel handshake and re-run CI.

Chris: also saw an SLO blip in eu-west earlier, linked to batcher queueing when concurrency peaked. correlating with KV misses.

oncall-bot: [ALERT] slo.p95.latency > 600ms (eu-west) — duration 5m — affected routes: /v1/generate, /v1/chat — incident: INC-2026-042. Pager: Maya oncall

Maya: noted. I rolled a transient config tweak (kv_cache_padding=1.2 -> 1.6) to reduce early eviction; monitoring.

Liam: I pushed a quick debounce change to the batcher alert rule (threshold -> 2m -> 30s window). early signal shows error-rate drop ~0.6%.

Liam: sharing the prometheus query I used to eyeball it:

```
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(http_request_duration_seconds_bucket{job=\"batcher\"}[5m])) by (le))
```

Ana: FYI I'm OOO tomorrow morning, reachable for urgent pages but won't be able to do deep dives. If you need me, ping Priya.

Priya: I'll queue the CR review for Maya's warmup patch in ~90m. @Chris if your CI fix merges first, I can rebase and run until green.

Chris: sounds good. plan: I'll push test-fix branch in ~20m, then open PR and request reviewers.

Maya: remaining todo today: document runbook steps for the batcher alert (prefix, kv warmup, rollback flag), follow up with postmortem notes in #postmortems if INC escalates.

Priya: quick heads-up, added a small note in the runbook draft about using `redis-cli --latency` to diagnose hot keys.

Maya: nice. small log excerpt from batcher showing the 504s for context:

```
[2026-05-02T03:14:22Z] warn batcher.go: queue_wait=128ms kv_miss=1 attempt=3 status=504 route=/v1/generate
[2026-05-02T03:14:23Z] info kv_cache.go: populate_keys=12 latency=72ms
```

Liam: FYI I'll leave the alert debounce change for 2 hours, then revert to previous if no regressions. :thumbsup:

Maya: thanks all — ping here if you hit the CI race or the INC. I'll update last check at ~18:00 UTC.
